catalog_description: A provenance-first index of diseases and evidence claims.

diseases.name: Alzheimer disease
diseases.overview: A neurodegenerative disease represented through phenotype, fluid biomarkers, disease-associated genes, and protein-processing pathways.

claims.statement: Amyloid-beta 42 and phosphorylated tau in cerebrospinal fluid are research biomarkers used in Alzheimer disease evaluation; interpretation depends on assay and clinical context.
APP, PSEN1, PSEN2, and APOE are represented as disease-associated or risk-modifying genes, with distinct inheritance and evidence profiles.

diseases.name: Type 2 diabetes mellitus
diseases.overview: A metabolic disease presented through glucose measurements, beta-cell and insulin-signaling biology, genetic risk, and phenotype annotations.

claims.statement: Glycated hemoglobin and plasma glucose measurements are used to assess glycemic status; a measurement is not by itself a complete disease mechanism.
TCF7L2, PPARG, KCNJ11, and ABCC8 are included as genetically supported relationships with different biological roles rather than interchangeable causal labels.

diseases.name: Parkinson disease
diseases.overview: A neurodegenerative disease presented through motor phenotypes, research biomarkers, mitochondrial quality-control pathways, and genetic evidence.

claims.statement: Alpha-synuclein and dopamine-transporter signal are represented as research or imaging biomarkers whose clinical meaning depends on method and context.
SNCA, LRRK2, PRKN, and PINK1 connect Parkinson disease to protein handling, kinase signaling, and mitochondrial quality-control hypotheses.
